spec_match.rationale: Real toBase64(), toBase64({alphabet:'base64url'}) and toHex() run on actual file bytes; each compat wrapper now probes its own exact method, so a partial engine falls back per-method instead of throwing; padding label corrected earlier.

interactive.rationale: File picker + drag-drop verified via CDP upload: info bar, all three encodings and the hex dump populate; tabs switch.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises client-side file → base64/hex with data URL preview; delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: 2MB cap enforced (alert), non-image preview degrades honestly; but clipboard failures are unhandled promises, and the alert() is a crude modal.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite passes live in the same browser.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless via CDP/puppeteer 2026-08-30 (feature natively supported — shipped Chrome 140): every button/sample/control driven, DOM readouts verified after each action, console clean (only sandbox-blocked external font fetch), zero page overflow at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3, full-page screenshots read. 18-byte sample.bin: b64 ends '/' → base64url ends '_', hex dump row matches bytes.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; tab active state flips background and color together; supported-state status text charcoal on stone (12+:1) after review.

accessibility.rationale: File input labelled and tabs are real buttons, but the tab bar lacks tablist/tab/aria-selected semantics and copy buttons give no announced feedback.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Zero overflow both classes; hex dump scrolls in its own container.

openQuestions.title: Give the tab bar real tab semantics and copy feedback
openQuestions.detail: role=tablist/tab with aria-selected plus a status line for the copy buttons (and a catch on the clipboard promise) would close the a11y gaps.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo layout without horizontal overflow mobile touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Design tokens, adequate touch targets, visible focus, honest capability handling.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Pages already use CSS variables throughout; verified zero page overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 for all six concepts; fixes kept the existing token-based styling.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP probe: documentElement.scrollWidth - clientWidth == 0 on all 6 concepts, both classes

guidanceConsulted.query: status message live region labelled form controls
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Label controls; surface state changes as text; keep native elements for keyboard support.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Existing labels/aria-labels verified; remaining gaps (status bars not aria-live, hex cells click-only) recorded as open questions rather than silently passed.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: page source review + CDP interaction transcript 2026-08-30
